permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Used to look up the weather forecast for where you are. A single location fix is taken in the background; your coordinates are never shown on screen.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Gets the weather forecast, downloads the speech recognition model once, and, only if you set one up, sends what you ask Jarvis to the AI you choose: Gemini, DeepSeek or Claude with your own key, or a model on your own computer.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: While the app is open, listens on the glasses microphone for "Hey Jarvis" (can be turned off) and records what you say to Jarvis. Listening happens on your phone; audio is never stored.
